summaries.text: This resolution honors the life and legacy of Rosa Parks by nationally recognizing Transit Equity Day. The resolution also encourages the use of public transportation and the continued work to make public transit accessible for all.

title: Expressing support for the designation of February 4, 2025, as "Transit Equity Day".
